description: This file declares the interface and factory for WebAudioPlayerIpc, a component responsible for inter-process communication related to web audio playback in the Rialto client. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and references to external protobuf messages and IPC mechanisms.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayerIpc.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Implements the IWebAudioPlayerIpc interface for web audio IPC communication, managing lifecycle, playback controls, and event handling.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayerIpc instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio stream.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a specified number of frames to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device capabilities such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the web audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the web audio player.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to IPC events from the server.

methods.name: onPlaybackStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to playback state events.
